note: Read 2026-10-30 on the Government of Oman's portal (gov.om), whose service pages are the Royal Oman Police's. 'Get a New Driving License': a temporary licence valid for one year, then replaced by a permanent one upon meeting the conditions; the beneficiary must be 18 for a light licence. The full licence is the one that replaces the temporary one, so its age is built from the stages: 18 plus the temporary year, 19 (a reading: the conditions of the replacement aren't listed). Fees: the temporary licence's issue costs 10 (rials; held as no fee of the full licence's); renewing a light vehicle licence costs 20 (a renewal's, not held); the full licence's own issue fee and its term weren't found: both null. A licence held 15 years may become a lifetime licence (fee 100, not held). Rop.gov.om didn't answer.
